LinkShelf

An open-source alternative to Linktree. Source on GitHub

Installation

LinkShelf ships as one image with frontend and backend and needs a Postgres or MySQL database. Pick the variant that fits your setup, the full guides are in the documentation on GitHub.

Docker

Run the image ghcr.io/m-mattia-m/linkshelf:latest with Docker Compose. The compose file and all settings are described in the Docker guide.

Kubernetes (Helm chart)

This site is the Helm chart repository:

helm repo add linkshelf https://m-mattia-m.github.io/LinkShelf
helm repo update
helm install linkshelf linkshelf/linkshelf

The chart needs existing Kubernetes Secrets and a database. See the Kubernetes guide for the required values. The raw repository index is index.yaml.
